Job Summary

Manage and operate the delivery truck performance and carry out routine daily maintenance on vehicles, involving conducting emergency roadside repairs, replacing light bulbs, and delivering items like sand, building materials, and other goods for clients or as a construction company, making sure that everything is in good working condition.

Job Responsibilities

Key
Metric

Manage and execute standard operations of a semi-tractor trailer for OTR drop and hook services.
Standard operations are well managed and executed.

Performing prescribed truck inspections before departure to ensure good running order.
Good running orders run well.

Supervising the loading and unloading of freight, and obtaining the client's signature on delivery.
The process of loading and unloading is carried out well.

Communicating any delays due to road conditions, accidents, or breakdowns to dispatchers.
Delays are well-communicated.

Maintain and actively implement SHE programs and responsibility (involve identify, mitigate and monitor SHE risk), including SHE Management System to ensure the effectiveness of the programs conform to official standard, requirements and procedure applied and to confirm the execution of the SHE Responsibility meet the intended outcome
- SHE risk well maintained

- Target Zero LTI

- SHE Management System meets the current ISO 14001, ISO 45001, SMK3 & SMKP standards and requirements

Education

Bachelor's Degree of Any major

Skill, Knowledge, and Experience

• Min. 3 - 5 years experiences in related field.
• Good negotiation and approaching skill.
• Having good communication and cooperation skill, either to the personal, organization and community.
• Having good self-awareness to the current role.
• Familiar to handle external issues.
• Having strong leadership.
• Fluent in English, both spoken and written is an advantage

Certification

• If candidates do not meet the requirements specified in the Education section, evaluation shall be conducted in accordance with KKNI Level 4.

Other Requirements

• SKK Supervisor Konstruksi Jenjang 7 (PUPR)
• BNSP Teknisi Konstruksi Senior

wo-klbf-JR26_000997.d:
Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

Job Description

- Operate production machinery and equipment, ensuring adherence to schedules and standards.
- Perform regular maintenance and repairs on equipment to ensure optimal performance.
- Identify and resolve production issues to minimize downtime.
- Ensure adherence to production schedules and standards, maintaining high levels of quality.
- Maintain a clean and safe work environment, following all safety protocols and regulations.
- Assist in the implementation of production improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce costs.
- Coordinate with other team members to ensure smooth production processes.

- Mengoperasikan mesin dan peralatan produksi, memastikan kepatuhan terhadap jadwal dan standar.
- Melakukan pemeliharaan dan perbaikan rutin pada peralatan untuk memastikan kinerja optimal.
- Mengidentifikasi dan memecahkan masalah produksi untuk meminimalkan waktu henti.
- Memastikan kepatuhan terhadap jadwal dan standar produksi, menjaga tingkat kualitas yang tinggi.
- Memelihara lingkungan kerja yang bersih dan aman, mengikuti semua protokol dan regulasi keselamatan.
- Mendukung implementasi perbaikan produksi untuk meningkatkan efisiensi dan mengurangi biaya.
- Berkoordinasi dengan anggota tim lain untuk memastikan proses produksi yang lancar.

Company:
DF PT. Dankos Farma

Job Description

- Shipment Execution: Execute the shipment process from preparation to the arrival of goods at the destination according to the established schedule.
- Shipping Coordination: Communicate with drivers, vendors, and third parties to ensure the smooth shipment of goods.
- Monitoring Shipment Status: Monitor the progress of goods and provide updates on the shipping status to relevant parties. Address issues or obstacles that arise during the shipping process.
- Administration and Documentation: Prepare and maintain documentation related to shipments, such as delivery notes, receipts, and daily reports.
- Safety Standards Compliance: Ensure all shipment processes are conducted according to applicable safety standards and adhere to regulations.
- Problem Resolution: Handle complaints or problems that may arise during the expedition process and strive to resolve them promptly.
- Collaboration with Other Teams: Work closely with warehouse, logistics, and transportation teams to ensure goods are properly loaded and shipped on schedule.

- Pelaksanaan Pengiriman: Melaksanakan proses pengiriman barang mulai dari persiapan hingga barang tiba di tujuan sesuai dengan jadwal yang telah ditetapkan.
- Koordinasi Pengiriman: Berkomunikasi dengan pengemudi, vendor, dan pihak ketiga untuk memastikan kelancaran proses pengiriman barang.
- Pemantauan Status Pengiriman: Memantau perjalanan barang dan memberikan pembaruan terkait status pengiriman kepada pihak terkait. Mengatasi masalah atau hambatan yang muncul selama proses pengiriman.
- Administrasi dan Dokumentasi: Menyusun dan memelihara dokumentasi terkait pengiriman, seperti surat jalan, tanda terima, dan laporan harian.
- Penerapan Standar Keselamatan: Memastikan seluruh proses pengiriman dilakukan sesuai dengan standar keselamatan yang berlaku dan mematuhi peraturan yang ditetapkan.
- Penanganan Masalah: Menangani keluhan atau permasalahan yang mungkin muncul selama proses ekspedisi dan berupaya untuk menyelesaikannya dengan cepat.
- Kolaborasi dengan Tim Lain: Bekerja sama dengan tim gudang, logistik, dan transportasi untuk memastikan barang diangkut dengan benar dan sesuai jadwal.

Company:
EPM PT. Enseval Putera Megatrading Tbk
